change_summary: Activate the v2 exit system: use_exit_signal was False, which disabled custom_exit entirely, so the thesis-reeval ownership exits (and v1 elite stomp) never fired. v3 sets it True.
reason_for_change: v2 deployed inert — freqtrade only calls custom_exit inside `if self.use_exit_signal:`. With it False, Timmy's only working exits were the harvest sleeve, trailing stop and hard stop; the decisive ownership-phase exits (opposite_bias, giveback, thesis_decay, stale_slot, reset) never executed. v3 turns the flag on so the v2 exit logic actually runs.
